description: This is a C source file for the CVXOPT library, implementing matrix and sparse matrix operations, including functions for matrix multiplication, element-wise operations, and conversions, with bindings to Python.

classes.name: matrix
classes.description: Represents dense matrices in the CVXOPT library.

classes.name: spmatrix
classes.description: Represents sparse matrices in the CVXOPT library.

methods.name: matrix_exp
methods.description: Computes the element-wise exponential of a matrix.

methods.name: matrix_log
methods.description: Computes the element-wise logarithm of a matrix.

methods.name: matrix_sqrt
methods.description: Computes the element-wise square root of a matrix.

methods.name: matrix_cos
methods.description: Computes the element-wise cosine of a matrix.

methods.name: matrix_sin
methods.description: Computes the element-wise sine of a matrix.

methods.name: base_axpy
methods.description: Performs y := alpha * x + y for matrices or sparse matrices.

methods.name: base_gemm
methods.description: Performs general matrix-matrix multiplication with support for transpositions and sparse matrices.

methods.name: base_gemv
methods.description: Performs general matrix-vector multiplication supporting sparse and dense matrices.

methods.name: base_syrk
methods.description: Performs rank-k update of symmetric matrices.

methods.name: base_symv
methods.description: Performs matrix-vector product with symmetric matrices.

methods.name: matrix_elem_mul
methods.description: Element-wise multiplication of matrices or sparse matrices.

methods.name: matrix_elem_div
methods.description: Element-wise division of matrices or sparse matrices.

methods.name: matrix_elem_min
methods.description: Element-wise minimum of matrices or sparse matrices.

methods.name: matrix_elem_max
methods.description: Element-wise maximum of matrices or sparse matrices.

methods.name: sparse
methods.description: Constructs a sparse matrix from dense or list inputs.

methods.name: spdiag
methods.description: Constructs a square block diagonal sparse matrix.
